title: Plugins Module
subtitle: Components that extend dashAI: models, converters, metrics, data loaders and more.

label.toggleHelp: Disabling it deletes nothing. Sessions, runs and chats that use its components can be viewed, but not run until you enable it.
label.retryLoadHelp: Turn it on to try loading it again.

empty.text: Find one in Explore or upload a plugin's .zip or folder to add models, converters, metrics or data loaders to dashAI.
empty.title: No plugins installed yet

github_attested.label: Verified
github_attested.text: GitHub certifies that this file was built by an automated process of the repository. dashAI checked that it was not modified.
github_attested.textBefore: GitHub certifies that this file was built by an automated process of the repository. dashAI checks that it was not modified.

github_source.label: Partially verified
github_source.text: The release only contains the source code. Unlike a verified plugin, there is no file built and checked by GitHub.
github_source.textBefore: The release only contains the source code. Unlike a verified plugin, there is no file built and checked by GitHub.

github_asset.label: Unverified
github_asset.text: The file comes from a GitHub release, but how it was built is not certified. It could contain code that is not in the repository.
github_asset.textBefore: The file comes from a GitHub release, but how it was built is not certified. It could contain code that is not in the repository.

local.label: Local
local.text: It was installed from a manually uploaded file. dashAI cannot confirm its author nor verify that it was not modified.
local.textBefore: It will be installed from a manually uploaded file. dashAI cannot confirm its author nor verify that it was not modified.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.text: It was installed with an earlier version of dashAI and its origin is not recorded. Reinstalling it reveals its trust level.

attested.label: Verified
attested.text: Its source certifies that this file was built by an automated process of the repository. dashAI checked that it was not modified.
attested.textBefore: Its source certifies that this file was built by an automated process of the repository. dashAI checks that it was not modified.

source.label: Partially verified
source.text: The release only contains the source code. Unlike a verified plugin, there is no file built and checked by its source.
source.textBefore: The release only contains the source code. Unlike a verified plugin, there is no file built and checked by its source.

unverified.label: Unverified
unverified.text: The file comes from a release, but how it was built is not certified. It could contain code that is not in the repository.
unverified.textBefore: The file comes from a release, but how it was built is not certified. It could contain code that is not in the repository.

local.label: Local
local.text: It was installed from a manually uploaded file. dashAI cannot confirm its author nor verify that it was not modified.
local.textBefore: It will be installed from a manually uploaded file. dashAI cannot confirm its author nor verify that it was not modified.

damaged.text: The plugin's own files (manifest.json or .source) can't be read. Reinstall or uninstall the plugin.
damaged.title: Damaged plugin

incompatible.text: It will work again once you install a version of the plugin compatible with this dashAI version, or once you update dashAI if the plugin needs a newer one.
incompatible.title: Incompatible with this dashAI version

load_failed.text: The plugin's code has an error that its author must fix.
load_failed.title: The plugin could not be loaded

repair_failed.text: When dashAI was updated, the plugin's Python packages couldn't be installed again. Restart dashAI with internet or reinstall the plugin.
repair_failed.title: Its Python packages are missing

restart_required.text: Its dependencies were updated. To use the plugin, restart dashAI.
restart_required.title: dashAI needs to be restarted

dependency_unavailable.title: Needs another plugin
dependency_unavailable.text: One of the plugins it needs is not installed, is disabled or has a problem. Check it in “Plugins it needs”.

dependency_version.title: Needs another version of a plugin
dependency_version.text: One of the plugins it needs has a version outside the range it asks for. Check it in “Plugins it needs”.

dialog.installBlocked: The store retired this plugin for security reasons. It will be installed blocked.
dialog.ackAuthor: I understand the risk and trust {{author}}
dialog.ackLocal: I understand the risk and trust the origin of this file
dialog.drop: Drop a .zip or the plugin's folder here
dialog.fromGithub: Install the latest release of a GitHub repository. If the repository is listed in the store, the plugin is linked to it and receives its updates and notices.
dialog.localWarning: A plugin runs code with the same permissions as dashAI and can access datasets and files. Only install files from a known origin.
dialog.upToDate: You already have the latest version.

version.sameRelease: It's the same version you have installed. You can install it anyway.
version.olderUpdate: It's an earlier version than the one you have installed, so it can't be an update.
version.older: It's an earlier version than the one you have installed.

dialog.inStore: This plugin is in the store: its updates and notices will come from it.
dialog.replacesOther: It replaces another plugin with this id, installed from {{location}}.
dialog.staysOff_one: {{names}} stays disabled; it will be enabled when you enable {{name}}.
dialog.staysOff_other: {{names}} stay disabled; they will be enabled when you enable {{name}}.
dialog.breaks_one: Installing this version will make {{names}} stop working, as it needs another version of {{name}}.
dialog.breaks_other: Installing this version will make {{names}} stop working, as they need another version of {{name}}.
dialog.willInstall_one: {{names}} will also be installed from the store.
dialog.willInstall_other: {{names}} will also be installed from the store.
dialog.willInstallOlder: {{name}} {{version}} will also be installed from the store. Its latest version requires updating dashAI.

allowBlocked.title: Turn on {{name}} anyway?
allowBlocked.text: The dashAI store retired it for security reasons. A plugin runs code with the same permissions as dashAI: turn it on only if you trust its source.

uninstall.text: {{name}} will be uninstalled. Its components are removed from dashAI and its files are deleted. Your sessions, runs, notebooks and chats are kept. Those that use its components can be viewed, but not run until you reinstall it.
uninstall.title: Confirm uninstall

settings.intro: The plugin's global settings. They apply to all its components, and the next job that runs uses them.
settings.inactiveText: Turn it on to change its settings. The saved values are kept.
settings.problemText: They can be changed once the problem above is solved. The saved values are kept.

message.install: {{name}} installed. Its components are now available.
message.noUpdates: All plugins are up to date.
message.restartRequired: Restart dashAI to use the components of {{name}}.
message.checkOffline: Couldn't connect to GitHub to check for updates. Check your internet connection.
message.checkFailed_one: Couldn't check for updates of {{count}} plugin.
message.checkFailed_other: Couldn't check for updates of {{count}} plugins.
message.storeCheckFailed: Could not check the plugin store.
message.installWith: {{name}} installed along with {{names}}. Its components are now available.
message.installedBefore_one: {{names}} was installed, but {{name}} could not be installed.
message.installedBefore_other: {{names}} were installed, but {{name}} could not be installed.
message.enableFailed: Could not enable {{dependency}}. {{name}} was left as it was.

errors.absolute_own_import: {{module}} imports its own module {{name}} absolutely. Use a relative import: {{suggestion}}
errors.cannot_update: This plugin has nowhere to update from. Upload the new version as a .zip.
errors.class_not_defined: The module {{module}} does not define the class {{class}}.
errors.dependency_conflict: The Python packages it needs are not compatible with those of this dashAI version or of another installed plugin.
errors.dependency_install_failed: Its Python packages could not be installed. Nothing changed. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.digest_mismatch: The download doesn't match what the store reviewed (different SHA-256), so nothing was installed. If it happens again, the author may have changed the release.
errors.fetch_failed: The plugin could not be downloaded.
errors.file_not_found: The file or folder was not found.
errors.forbidden_origin: Plugins can only be managed from dashAI.
errors.incompatible: This plugin is not compatible with this dashAI version.
errors.install_failed: The operation could not be completed.
errors.invalid_archive: The release file could not be opened.
errors.invalid_location: This is not a valid address.
errors.invalid_id: The id “{{id}}” is not valid. Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (for example “my-plugin”).
errors.invalid_manifest: The manifest.json is not valid. Check: {{fields}}.
errors.invalid_settings: Some values are no longer valid (the plugin may have changed). Its settings were read again.
errors.invalid_zip: The file is not a valid .zip.
errors.job_running: A training, a prediction or another job is running, and changing dependencies now could mix versions in it. Nothing changed: try again when it finishes.
errors.load_failed: Its code could not be loaded in dashAI.
errors.manifest_not_found: This is not a plugin: there is no manifest.json at its root.
errors.missing_dependencies: Its Python packages are missing. Restart dashAI with an internet connection or reinstall it.
errors.module_not_found: The module {{module}} of the component {{component}} was not found.
errors.needs_newer_dashai: It needs dashAI {{required}} or newer, and this is {{current}}.
errors.no_newer_version: Version {{installed}} is installed, and the latest release is {{latest}}.
errors.not_found: The repository {{repo}} was not found. Private repositories are not supported.
errors.offline: Could not connect. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.other_dashai: Another dashAI is open on the same data folder and is installing or removing a plugin. Nothing changed: try again when it finishes.
errors.overwrites_other_package: One of its dependencies ({{packages}}) would overwrite files of {{other}}, which another installed plugin uses. Nothing was installed.
errors.pip_unavailable: dashAI cannot install dependencies on this computer because pip is not available.
errors.preview_expired: What you reviewed is no longer kept (it was installed already, or too much time went by), so nothing was installed. Review it again.
errors.preview_mismatch: What you reviewed is another plugin, or comes from elsewhere, so it can't update this one. Nothing was installed.
errors.rate_limited: The request limit GitHub allows without a token was reached. Requests are possible again at {{time}}. With a GitHub token in Credentials, the limit rises to 5000 requests per hour.
errors.rate_limited_later: The request limit GitHub allows without a token was reached. With a GitHub token in Credentials, the limit rises to 5000 requests per hour.
errors.revoked: The store withdrew this release for security reasons, so nothing was installed.
errors.settings_unavailable: Its settings are not available. The plugin must be on and have no problems.
errors.store_mismatch: What was downloaded is not what the store reviewed, so nothing was installed.
errors.syntax_error: There is a syntax error in {{module}} (line {{line}}).
errors.too_big: The file exceeds the {{max_mb}} MB maximum for a plugin. A plugin carries code: data and weights are downloaded by its components when used.
errors.type_not_allowed: The component {{component}} is of a type dashAI does not support ({{type}}).
errors.unsafe_zip: The .zip has paths that leave its folder and cannot be installed.
errors.missing_plugin_dependency: Needs the plugin “{{id}}”, which is neither installed nor published in the store. Install it first from a .zip or GitHub.
errors.incompatible_plugin_dependency: Needs the plugin “{{id}}”. It is in the store, but none of its versions works with this dashAI version.
errors.missing_plugin_dependency_unread: Needs the plugin “{{id}}”, which is not installed. The store could not be checked for it.
errors.dependency_unavailable: Needs {{name}}, which can't be turned on ({{problem}}). Check that plugin in Plugins.
errors.dependency_inactive: Needs the plugin “{{id}}”, which is not active. Nothing was installed.
errors.dependency_cycle: The plugins {{ids, list}} need each other, so none of them can be installed.
errors.plugin_dependency_version: Needs the plugin “{{id}}” at version {{required}}, and version {{installed}} is installed.
errors.plugin_dependency_version_store: Needs the plugin “{{id}}” at version {{required}}, and the store offers none in that range.

unavailable.readOnly: Saved results can be viewed and deleted. Running again requires that component.
unavailable.disabled_one: {{names}} is provided by {{plugin}}, which is disabled.
unavailable.disabled_other: {{names}} are provided by {{plugin}}, which is disabled.
unavailable.problem_one: {{names}} is provided by {{plugin}}, which has a problem.
unavailable.problem_other: {{names}} are provided by {{plugin}}, which has a problem.
unavailable.uninstalled_one: No installed plugin provides {{names}}. If you uninstalled it, reinstall it to use this again.
unavailable.uninstalled_other: No installed plugin provides {{names}}. If you uninstalled it, reinstall it to use them again.
unavailable.checkFailed: The available components could not be checked. Try again.

store.readFailed: Could not read the plugin store. Check your internet connection.
store.empty: The store has no plugins yet.
store.readmeFailed: Could not load the README. Check your internet connection.

blocked.title: Blocked by the store
blocked.text: dashAI stopped loading it because the store retired it for security reasons. You can uninstall it or, if you trust its source, turn it on anyway.

allowedAnyway.title: Turned on anyway
allowedAnyway.text: The store blocked this plugin for security reasons and you turned it on anyway. If the store blocks it again, it will be turned off again.

removed.title: Retired from the store
removed.text: It keeps working, but it will no longer get updates.

installedOther.title: You already have another plugin with this id installed

requiresDashai.title: Requires a newer version of dashAI

newerNeedsDashai.title: A new version of the plugin is available
newerNeedsDashai.text: To install {{version}}, update dashAI to {{dashai}} or later.

store.invalid: The plugin store answered something this version of dashAI can't read.
store.unverified: The plugin store's signature could not be verified, so the download was not used.
store.rateLimited: GitHub limited the requests to the plugin store. Try again later.
store.allInstalled: Every plugin in the store is already installed.

dev.hint: Install it from a .zip or a GitHub URL.
